historical_record.description: The 14,100-square-foot M-1 lot, with 60 feet of frontage on both Bayshore Boulevard and Barneveld Avenue and 235 feet deep, was used by a towing service to store inoperable vehicles. The City Planning Commission unanimously approved, by Resolution No. 6999 with conditions, continued temporary storage of inoperable vehicles by a tow service, with no dismantling on the site.
